findings.evidenceJa: 怖い夢を見ている
findings.governingReading: Sakura is having the frightening dream again.
findings.explanation: The English uses unnatural “seeing the ... dream” phrasing.

findings.evidenceJa: ヒタヒタと道を歩いていく
findings.governingReading: The entity pads wetly or softly along the road.
findings.explanation: The English omits the sound and manner of its movement.

findings.evidenceJa: 少し遅れたところからわたしは眺めている
findings.governingReading: Sakura watches from a position slightly behind the entity.
findings.explanation: The English omits the measured separation between observer and entity.

findings.highlight: A nightmare I’m seeing over and over
findings.evidenceJa: ここのところずっと、繰り返し見続けている悪い夢
findings.governingReading: She has continuously kept seeing the nightmare throughout the recent period.
findings.explanation: The English retains repetition but omits its sustained recent duration.

findings.highlight: I feel a sense of intimacy with it
findings.evidenceJa: 少しだけ親近感が湧いていた
findings.governingReading: Sakura has begun to feel only a slight affinity or familiarity with it.
findings.explanation: The English strengthens limited affinity into intimacy.

findings.evidenceJa: こんなふうに夜中出歩くだけで、食べ物の方からやってきてくれる
findings.governingReading: Simply wandering outside at night makes the prey come to the entity on their own.
findings.explanation: The English omits the nocturnal wandering and self-arriving mechanism.

findings.evidenceJa: 心も体も
findings.governingReading: The entity consumes both mind or heart and body.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes the technically distinct soul for mind or heart.

findings.evidenceJa: くすくすと歌ってゴーゴー
findings.governingReading: The entity proceeds with a playful, giggling sing-song refrain.
findings.explanation: The English flattens the voice into a bare imperative-like phrase.

findings.highlight: it seems to be happy tonight
findings.evidenceJa: 今夜はとても嬉しそうだ
findings.governingReading: Tonight the previously emotionless entity looks extremely happy.
findings.explanation: The English removes the degree of its unprecedented happiness.

findings.highlight: I feel like continuing this bad dream
findings.evidenceJa: もう少しぐらいは見続けてあげてもいい
findings.governingReading: Sakura indulgently thinks she may keep watching the dream a little longer for its sake.
findings.explanation: The English removes both the limited duration and benefactive indulgence.

findings.evidenceJa: 見ていて可哀相なほど取り乱して
findings.governingReading: The entity becomes so distraught that it is painful or pitiable to watch.
findings.explanation: The English retains panic but removes Sakura’s sympathetic evaluation.

findings.highlight: I never expected to reach the actual thing
findings.evidenceJa: まさかアレに届くほど完成するとはな
findings.governingReading: Gilgamesh says the failed Grail unexpectedly became complete enough to reach “that,” leaving the referent unstated here.
findings.explanation: The English invents “the actual thing” as a confident resolution of the withheld referent.

findings.highlight: Curse yourself for being too compatible
findings.evidenceJa: 死にゆく前に
findings.governingReading: Gilgamesh orders her to curse her excessive compatibility before she dies.
findings.explanation: The English omits the imminent-death timing of the command.

findings.highlight: the thing is showered with weapons
findings.evidenceJa: たくさんの刃物で滅多刺しにされてしまった
findings.governingReading: The entity is savagely stabbed over and over with numerous blades.
findings.explanation: The English removes both repeated piercing and the bladed nature of the weapons.

findings.evidenceJa: 後ろから見ているわたしが痛い
findings.governingReading: Sakura asks why she hurts when she is supposedly watching the stabbed entity from behind.
findings.explanation: The English omits the spatial observer distinction whose collapse drives the scene.

findings.evidenceJa: ズタズタにされてる
findings.governingReading: Sakura realizes her own body has been shredded or torn to pieces.
findings.explanation: The English weakens catastrophic bodily destruction to being cut up.

findings.evidenceJa: みっともないですよね
findings.governingReading: Sakura calls the exposed bodily state unsightly or pathetic.
findings.explanation: The English sexualizes or moralizes the gore as “obscene.”

findings.highlight: they’re just dangling from my body
findings.evidenceJa: 足と繋がっている身体がブラブラブラ
findings.governingReading: The body attached to Sakura’s legs hangs or flaps loosely.
findings.explanation: The English reverses the relation and makes the legs dangle from the body.

findings.evidenceJa: まだ息があるのか。生き汚いな、娘
findings.governingReading: Gilgamesh remarks that she is still breathing and contemptuously calls her tenaciously attached to life.
findings.explanation: The English leaves the entire repeated line blank.

findings.highlight: summons a blade that’s bigger than my body
findings.evidenceJa: わたしの体よりおっきな刃物で
findings.governingReading: The golden man moves to sever her neck with a blade larger than her body.
findings.explanation: The English invents an explicit summoning action.

findings.evidenceJa: わたしまで、一緒にこのまま
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s broken plea reaches the fear that she too will remain like this together with the entity.
findings.explanation: The English drops the shared-destruction fragment before the interruption.

findings.evidenceJa: 夢から
findings.governingReading: The isolated fragment repeats “from the dream,” leading into inability to escape it.
findings.explanation: The English changes the grammatical fragment and weakens the repetition.

findings.evidenceJa: 磔にされた虫のように
findings.governingReading: The impaled woman lies prostrate like an insect pinned in crucifixion.
findings.explanation: The English omits the pinning or crucifixion that connects her posture to the Noble Phantasms.

findings.evidenceJa: 未練がましく
findings.governingReading: She tries to move from a pathetic, lingering attachment to life.
findings.explanation: The English changes motivation and characterization into speed or agitation.

findings.evidenceJa: 先輩が、わたしを、見て、くれた
findings.governingReading: Sakura clings to the happiness that Shirou finally saw and acknowledged her.
findings.explanation: The English promotes being seen into acceptance.

findings.highlight: I want him to feel more of me
findings.evidenceJa: もっと、もっと、触れて、ほしかった
findings.governingReading: Sakura wanted Shirou to touch her more and more.
findings.explanation: The English changes the direction and object of touch into him feeling more of her, adding a more sexualized implication.

findings.highlight: She must not see anything now
findings.evidenceJa: もう何も見えていないのか
findings.governingReading: The narrator asks whether the woman can no longer see anything.
findings.explanation: The English turns a question into confident inference.

findings.highlight: The woman babbles about her mundane wish
findings.evidenceJa: 最後まで夢うつつのまま、女はつまらない望みを口にする
findings.governingReading: Still half in a dream to the end, the woman voices her trivial wish.
findings.explanation: The English omits the half-dreaming state and invents incoherent babbling.

findings.evidenceJa: 先輩は、姉さん、に
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s broken fear retains Shirou as the subject in relation to her sister.
findings.explanation: The English makes the sister the subject and drops Shirou from the fragment.

findings.evidenceJa: 断頭の剣が落ちる
findings.governingReading: The sword of decapitation falls.
findings.explanation: The English changes the weapon into an execution apparatus.

findings.highlight: consciousness disappears in the dirty back alley
findings.evidenceJa: 覚める事なく、薄汚れた路地裏で消え去った
findings.governingReading: Her consciousness vanishes in the filthy alley without ever waking.
findings.explanation: The English omits the failure to wake that closes the dream-denial sequence.

findings.evidenceJa: いつもより、少しだけ時間がかかった
findings.governingReading: Consuming Gilgamesh takes only slightly longer than usual.
findings.explanation: The English leaves the entire understated reversal blank.

findings.evidenceJa: いたい。少ないから、治らないんだ
findings.governingReading: The shadow says it still hurts and that the small amount is insufficient to heal it.
findings.explanation: The English leaves the entire pain and failed-healing statement blank.

findings.highlight: a heroic spirit with energy worth a few hundred thousand souls
findings.evidenceJa: 魂の比重、実に数十万人に該当する英雄王
findings.governingReading: The Hero King’s soul has a specific weight equivalent to tens or hundreds of thousands of people.
findings.explanation: The English changes soul-weight into energy value and replaces people with souls.

findings.evidenceJa: 足りない。こんなんじゃ、足りない
findings.governingReading: The shadow repeats that this amount is not enough.
findings.explanation: The English leaves the entire hunger refrain blank.

findings.evidenceJa: 飼育箱へと歩き出した
findings.governingReading: For the first time by its own will, the entity starts toward the rearing box or enclosure.
findings.explanation: The English changes the recurring container motif into a broad area.
